prompt:
I'm a freelance ML engineer and things are getting chaotic. I have a file at notes/activity_notes.txt with some updates from the past couple of days about work I've done and issues I've resolved across my projects. I need you to first apply all those updates to my project tracking system, then give me a full priority assessment so I know what to focus on today. I've got about 90 minutes of focused energy available right now.

Please save the priority assessment as priority_report.json. It should include a ranked breakdown of all my projects, a single clear recommendation for what to work on right now, an alternative option, any projects I should be worried about because they've gone cold, and a suggestion for what kind of work session I should plan given my available time.
